answer: The tide counter is kept in inlet and pulse shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An hostile operator hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 109 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
